fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for change set 01M6JBK. rhiza rex install wrote the installing host's absolute rhiza path into rhiza.lua, so app actions failed on a Rex pane hosted on the VM. One question was raised (how the actions find rhiza); the arbiter answered with Decision rex-actions-run-rhiza-from-path: run bare "rhiza" from the executing host's PATH, with an optional settings.bin override kept across reinstalls. One leaf planned under rex-install-command. No owner words: the run had no owner.
fields.title: Plan of rex install's rhiza path, autonomous run
